$comment: Language-neutral conformance cases against an inline synthetic catalog revision (not published). Covers strong and weak identity, ambiguity, version selection (matched, out of range, unparseable), intent selection, native-architecture defaults, exact vs neutral overlays, dependency records, platform-cased invocation names, and floor composition. See bundled-catalog.json for the case format. `host` overrides the simulated host (default linux/x64).
